name: InnoDB行锁级联: blocker空闲
cause: 行锁等待低 — blocker 可能在等 IO 或空闲未提交
findings: 存在阻塞链但行锁争用速率不高，blocker 可能是空闲未提交事务
需定位 root blocker 状态（Sleep/IO等待/执行中）
actions: [紧急] 定位 root blocker 及其状态 | SQL: SELECT b.BLOCKING_THREAD_ID, t.PROCESSLIST_USER, t.PROCESSLIST_COMMAND, t.PROCESSLIST_STATE, t.PROCESSLIST_TIME, LEFT(t.PROCESSLIST_INFO, 200) AS sql_text, COUNT(*) AS victims FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits b JOIN performance_schema.threads t ON t.THREAD_ID = b.BLOCKING_THREAD_ID GROUP BY b.BLOCKING_THREAD_ID ORDER BY victims DESC LIMIT 5
[排查] 检查 InnoDB 锁状态 | SQL: SHOW ENGINE INNODB STATUS

name: InnoDB行锁级联: blocker跑慢SQL
cause: > 50% — 大量临时表溢出到磁盘
findings: 超过 50% 的临时表溢出到磁盘，I/O 开销大
常见原因：SQL 使用 TEXT/BLOB 列、GROUP BY/ORDER BY 结果集过大、tmp_table_size 过小
actions: [修复] 增大 tmp_table_size 和 max_heap_table_size | SQL: SET GLOBAL tmp_table_size=134217728; SET GLOBAL max_heap_table_size=134217728

[排查] 查找产生磁盘临时表的 SQL | SQL: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES, COUNT_STAR FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES > 0 ORDER BY SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES DESC LIMIT 10

name: 死锁检测
cause: 行锁等待高 — blocker 持有大量行锁
findings: 存在阻塞链且行锁等待高，root blocker 持锁不释放
大事务或未提交事务阻塞其他会话
actions: [紧急] 定位 root blocker 并查看其 SQL | SQL: SELECT b.BLOCKING_THREAD_ID, t.PROCESSLIST_USER, t.PROCESSLIST_TIME, LEFT(t.PROCESSLIST_INFO, 200) AS blocker_sql, COUNT(*) AS victim_count FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits b JOIN performance_schema.threads t ON t.THREAD_ID = b.BLOCKING_THREAD_ID GROUP BY b.BLOCKING_THREAD_ID ORDER BY victim_count DESC LIMIT 5

[紧急] 查找运行时间最长的事务 | SQL: SELECT trx_id, trx_started, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,trx_started,NOW()) duration_sec, trx_rows_locked, trx_rows_modified, trx_mysql_thread_id FROM information_schema.innodb_trx ORDER BY trx_started LIMIT 5
[修复] KILL 阻塞源会话或等待其事务提交 | SQL: -- KILL {blocker_thread_id}

name: Metadata Lock阻塞DML
cause: 5-50/s — 中度异常断开
findings: Aborted_clients 5-50/s，存在客户端异常断开
检查网络质量和应用连接管理逻辑
actions: [排查] 检查连接状态 | SQL: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Aborted%'; SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Connection%'

name: Gap Lock阻塞INSERT
cause: 全表扫描正常
findings: 有慢查询但全表扫描不多，检查其他原因
actions: [排查] 检查 innodb_stats_persistent 配置 | SQL: SELECT @@innodb_stats_persistent, @@innodb_stats_auto_recalc, @@innodb_stats_persistent_sample_pages

name: Next-Key Lock并发INSERT死锁
cause: redo_rate > 200 MB/s — Binlog 快速增长
findings: Redo 写入速率极高 (> 200 MB/s)，Binlog 快速增长
如未及时清理，Binlog 可能占满磁盘空间
actions: [排查] 检查 Binlog 保留策略 | SQL: SELECT @@binlog_expire_logs_seconds, @@expire_logs_days
[修复] 设置 Binlog 过期时间 | SQL: SET GLOBAL binlog_expire_logs_seconds=259200 -- 3 天
[修复] 手动清理旧 Binlog | SQL: PURGE BINARY LOGS BEFORE DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)

actions: [紧急] 定位全表扫描的 SQL 并优化 | SQL: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED, COUNT_STAR FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 ORDER BY COUNT_STAR DESC LIMIT 10

name: Aborted Clients冲高

findings: 超过 50% 的临时表溢出到磁盘，I/O 开销大

actions: [修复] 增大 tmp_table_size 和 max_heap_table_size | SQL: SET GLOBAL tmp_table_size=134217728; SET GLOBAL max_heap_table_size=134217728

[排查] 查找产生磁盘临时表的 SQL | SQL: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES, COUNT_STAR FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES > 0 ORDER BY SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES DESC LIMIT 10
